issues.evidence: 'Bring in your team. People, and their assistants, on the same files.' and the end card 'Your team and their agents.' rest on a demo session with a scripted teammate (labelled 'DEMO SESSION, SIMULATED TEAMMATE', which is good). CAPTURE_LOG: 'Invite my Assistant' timed out twice, and the Accept click threw an error toast. The brief says the prototype is not release proof.
issues.suggested_action: Keep the label. Make shipping confirmation of Room plus proposals a release gate. Until then, soften the VO to 'Bring in your team, and their assistants' proposals' and do not imply that your own assistant joins.

issues.evidence: Super 'Five minutes. For one number.' plus the chatbot's 'about 5 min left' and the VO 'Wait again. Five minutes... for one number.' This is a specific minute figure tied to a competitor-category tool, and the brief bans 'fabricated minutes ... or competitive benchmark'. The product owner explicitly chose to keep it. It is noted here, not blocking.
issues.suggested_action: If it stays, keep it clearly inside the labelled illustration. Never pair it with any product timing, and do not reuse it in cutdowns without the ILLUSTRATION label.

issues.evidence: 'Your files, stored on your device.' is large cyan. The required 'Cloud AI may process document content.' is small grey text at roughly a quarter the size, on screen for about 3 s. The next card, 'Built around your local workspace.', carries no disclaimer.
issues.suggested_action: Raise the disclaimer to legible contrast and size (at least 60% of the subline size), hold it through 105.3, and keep the product team's data-flow sign-off as a release gate.
